name: Deer
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats only plants

features.claim: A deer has long, strong legs.
features.quote: Characteristics typical of deer include long, powerful legs, a diminutive tail and long ears.

features.claim: A deer has a very small tail.
features.quote: Characteristics typical of deer include long, powerful legs, a diminutive tail and long ears.
Characteristics typical of deer include long, powerful legs, a diminutive tail and long ears.

features.claim: A deer's coat is usually red or brown.
features.quote: Coat colour generally varies between red and brown, though it can be as dark as chocolate brown in the tufted deer or have a grayish tinge as in elk.

features.claim: A deer has a gland on its face in front of each eye.
features.quote: Nearly all deer have a facial gland in front of each eye.

features.claim: Male deer have antlers on their heads.
features.quote: All male deer have antlers, with the exception of the water deer, in which males have long tusk-like canines that reach below the lower jaw.

features.claim: A deer's antlers are made of bone growing out of the skull.
features.quote: These antlers are bony extensions of the skull and are often used for combat between males.

features.claim: A young deer is often born with white spots on its fur.
features.quote: Most fawns are born with their fur covered with white spots, though in many species they lose these spots by the end of their first winter.

not_this.claim: It is wrong to draw a female deer with antlers, except for reindeer.
not_this.quote: Only male deer have antlers, except for reindeer (caribou), where both sexes carry antlers.

not_this.claim: It is wrong to draw a deer with permanent horns like a cow's.
not_this.quote: deer are strongly distinguished from antelopes by their antlers, which are temporary and regularly regrown unlike the permanent horns of bovids

second_reading.claim: A deer has a four-chambered stomach.
second_reading.quote: Deer are ruminants, or cud-chewers, and have a four-chambered stomach.

second_reading.claim: A deer has no upper front teeth, but a tough pad at the front of its upper jaw.
second_reading.quote: The teeth of deer are adapted to feeding on vegetation, and like other ruminants, they lack upper incisors, instead having a tough pad at the front of their upper jaw.

second_reading.claim: A deer's eyes shine at night because of a tapetum lucidum.
